asked.item: Canceled screen while Billing says ACTIVE
Do I have to pay a second time to get in

verdict.reason: The help page covers this case: Billing shows ACTIVE but the canceled screen still appears. It says not to pay again and gives the fix.

steps.text: If Billing shows your subscription is ACTIVE but you still see the canceled/reactivate screen, do not pay again.
The lock screen is stale on your browser.
Clear your browser cache, then log in again at my.blotato.com/login with your exact account email, spelled in all lowercase.
